  html_document:

```{r, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# 1. Read the data
dt <- read.csv('meta.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat('<table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Screenshot</th><th>Project</th><th>Links</th></tr></thead><tbody>')

for(i in 1:nrow(dt)){
  repo_path <- trimws(dt$viz_owner_repo[i])
  
  # Logic: If repo is 'aakritixyz/ten-points-animint'
  # The image is at '[https://aakritixyz.github.io/ten-points-animint/Capture.PNG](https://aakritixyz.github.io/ten-points-animint/Capture.PNG)'
  repo_only <- gsub("aakritixyz/", "", repo_path)
  img_src <- paste0("[https://aakritixyz.github.io/](https://aakritixyz.github.io/)", repo_only, "/Capture.PNG")
  demo_url <- paste0("[https://aakritixyz.github.io/](https://aakritixyz.github.io/)", repo_only, "/")

  cat('<tr>')
  # Added an 'onerror' to try lowercase if Uppercase fails
  cat(paste0('<td><img src="', img_src, '" width="250" onerror="this.src=\'', tolower(img_src), '\'"></td>'))
  cat(paste0('<td><b>', dt$title[i], '</b></td>'))
  cat(paste0('<td><a href="', demo_url, '">Demo</a><br><a href="', dt$source[i], '">Source</a></td>'))
  cat('</tr>')
}
cat('</tbody></table>')
